Class AdminHomePage

java.lang.Object
UI.Pages.AdminHomePage
All Implemented Interfaces:
IInitializable
public class AdminHomePage extends Object implements IInitializable
AdminPage class represents the user interface for the admin user. This page displays a simple welcome message for the admin.
